name: briefing_action_queue_add_fade_in_element
description: Briefing_ActionQueue::AddFadeInElement allocates a fade-in action, stores the target element, initializes alpha to zero, inserts it into the briefing action queue, and returns the updated node count.
known_limits: Focused VC5 COFF byte comparison is clean in briefing_action_queue_add_methods; owner tier S remains deferred to the complete Briefing source-owner because tick bodies and the runtime constructor remain byte-blocked.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x4046d0 validates allocation of a 12-byte fade action, target storage, alpha initialization to 0.0, queue-node insertion, node-count increment, and return of the updated count.
The native briefing objective-action smoke verifies fade actions for the objective-picture widget and alpha initialization.
